propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; it must become per-project config-driven via resolve_for_project, falling back to built-in local_to_jira_status when no override exists.
Unmapped local statuses must drift (omit status field from Jira mutation) with a deduped warning, never coerce or skip.

Round-trip of remapped and collapsed statuses via rebar-status:<local> labels requires a generalized stamp rule (label iff Jira target != built-in canonical) and inbound recovery using a derived vocabulary of all local status values.
The outbound differ must resolve the effective status map per-project using repo_root (not CWD) and thread it through CREATE and UPDATE mappers.
Config-declared Jira status names must be tolerated by both the fetcher known-set and preflight_status_mapping validation.
The duplicated _REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL literal must be replaced by a single shared helper re-exported in applier.__all__.
